title: umanyano olubizele intshabalalo
intro: Khawuzithelekelele ukhuselekile phantsi kophahla olufanayo nesityhilelo, kodwa ukhethe ukuthembeka okwahlukileyo. Lo mntu wayephila kufutshane nenyaniso nomprofeti, kodwa wajika waya kwabo bangazange bayivume. Ibali labo lisisilumkiso esinzulu sokuba ukusondela ebulungiseni kuphela akunakusindisa umphefumlo ongcatsha ithemba.
clues: Ndandiyazi inyaniso eyayishunyayelwa ngumyeni wam, kodwa ndandingayikholelwa ngokwenene.
Ndamngcatsha ngokuba yinxalenye yabantu bakhe abamchasayo nokubanceda bamchase.
Ndikhankanywa kunye neqabane lomnye umprofeti naye owangcatshayo, njengomzekelo kwabangakholwayo.
Ibali lam lichazwe kwiSurah At-Tahrim njengesilumkiso sokuba ulwalamano nabaprofeti aluniki khuseleko.
Ndatshabalala kunye nabenzi bobubi xa uAllah wabatshabalalisa abantu bakaLut, ndasala nabo baseleyo.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
